title: Aerosafe static companion and replication artefacts
description: Versioned companion artefacts for Aerosafe, including the complete 52-control catalogue, AMLAS-ECSS-Aerosafe source/status records, construction and execution fields, the guided project workflow, the bounded IMVV application, and anonymised descriptive data for two practitioner evaluations.
